title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
title_zh: BrowserSkill连接Cursor, Claude Code, Codex等AI代理到您的登录浏览器

paragraphs.en: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
paragraphs.zh: 让 AI 智能体使用你真实的、已登录的浏览器，而不打断你的工作。 通过 CLI 加浏览器扩展，实现跨任意具备 shell 能力的 AI 智能体的浏览器自动化。

sents.en: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work.
sents.zh: 让 AI 智能体使用你真实的、已登录的浏览器，而不打断你的工作。

sents.en: CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
sents.zh: 通过 CLI 加浏览器扩展，实现跨任意具备 shell 能力的 AI 智能体的浏览器自动化。

paragraphs.en: Let AI agents work in your logged-in browser while you keep working.
paragraphs.zh: 让 AI 智能体在你已登录的浏览器中工作，而你继续做自己的事。

paragraphs.en: Quick start · Website debugging · DSH plugin · Documentation · Changelog
paragraphs.zh: 快速入门 · 网站调试 · DSH 插件 · 文档 · 更新日志

paragraphs.en: BrowserSkill connects your AI agent to Chrome or Microsoft Edge, using the accounts you are already signed into. Ask it to read pages, fill forms, work through a website, capture a long screenshot, or investigate a failing request. Tasks run in a separate, visible Agent Window ; an existing tab can be explicitly borrowed and returned when the task ends.
paragraphs.zh: BrowserSkill 将你的 AI 智能体连接到 Chrome 或 Microsoft Edge，并使用你已登录的账户。 让它读取页面、填写表单、在网站上完成操作、截取长截图，或排查失败的请求。 任务在独立且可见的智能体窗口（Agent Window）中运行；也可以显式借用现有标签页，并在任务结束后归还。

sents.en: BrowserSkill connects your AI agent to Chrome or Microsoft Edge, using the accounts you are already signed into.
sents.zh: BrowserSkill 将你的 AI 智能体连接到 Chrome 或 Microsoft Edge，并使用你已登录的账户。

sents.en: Ask it to read pages, fill forms, work through a website, capture a long screenshot, or investigate a failing request.
sents.zh: 让它读取页面、填写表单、在网站上完成操作、截取长截图，或排查失败的请求。

sents.en: Tasks run in a separate, visible Agent Window ; an existing tab can be explicitly borrowed and returned when the task ends.
sents.zh: 任务在独立且可见的智能体窗口（Agent Window）中运行；也可以显式借用现有标签页，并在任务结束后归还。

paragraphs.en: Use the bsk CLI with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, Pi, Hermes Agent, or another shell-capable agent. DeepSeek Harness has a dedicated plugin with native browser tools and task previews. You choose the agent and model; BrowserSkill provides the browser connection.
paragraphs.zh: 将 bsk CLI 与 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、Pi、Hermes Agent 或其他具备 shell 能力的智能体配合使用。 DeepSeek Harness 有一个专用插件，提供原生浏览器工具和任务预览。 由你选择智能体和模型；BrowserSkill 提供浏览器连接。

sents.en: Use the bsk CLI with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, Pi, Hermes Agent, or another shell-capable agent.
sents.zh: 将 bsk CLI 与 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、Pi、Hermes Agent 或其他具备 shell 能力的智能体配合使用。

sents.en: DeepSeek Harness has a dedicated plugin with native browser tools and task previews.
sents.zh: DeepSeek Harness 有一个专用插件，提供原生浏览器工具和任务预览。

sents.en: You choose the agent and model; BrowserSkill provides the browser connection.
sents.zh: 由你选择智能体和模型；BrowserSkill 提供浏览器连接。

paragraphs.en: For local automation, you need an AI agent + the bsk CLI + the browser extension . The CLI includes the background daemon. The skill teaches your agent how to use it.
paragraphs.zh: 对于本地自动化，你需要一个智能体 + bsk CLI + 浏览器扩展。 该 CLI 包含后台守护进程。 该技能会教你的智能体如何使用它。

sents.en: For local automation, you need an AI agent + the bsk CLI + the browser extension .
sents.zh: 对于本地自动化，你需要一个智能体 + bsk CLI + 浏览器扩展。

sents.en: The CLI includes the background daemon.
sents.zh: 该 CLI 包含后台守护进程。

sents.en: The skill teaches your agent how to use it.
sents.zh: 该技能会教你的智能体如何使用它。

paragraphs.en: Set up browser-skill on this machine by following https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/AGENT_INSTALL.md The guide covers CLI installation, the correct skill or DSH plugin, connection checks, and a first browser task. You will still need to install the extension in the browser you want to use:
paragraphs.zh: 按照 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/AGENT_INSTALL.md 在本机上安装 browser-skill。该指南涵盖 CLI 安装、正确的 skill 或 DSH 插件、连接检查以及第一个浏览器任务。 你仍需要在要使用的浏览器中安装该扩展：

sents.en: Set up browser-skill on this machine by following https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/AGENT_INSTALL.md The guide covers CLI installation, the correct skill or DSH plugin, connection checks, and a first browser task.
sents.zh: 按照 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/AGENT_INSTALL.md 在本机上安装 browser-skill。该指南涵盖 CLI 安装、正确的 skill 或 DSH 插件、连接检查以及第一个浏览器任务。

sents.en: You will still need to install the extension in the browser you want to use:
sents.zh: 你仍需要在要使用的浏览器中安装该扩展：

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/install.sh | sh export PATH= " ${BSK_INSTALL_DIR :- $HOME / .local / bin} : $PATH " Windows PowerShell:
paragraphs.zh: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/install.sh | sh export PATH= " ${BSK_INSTALL_DIR :- $HOME / .local / bin} : $PATH " Windows PowerShell:

paragraphs.en: irm https: // raw.githubusercontent.com / Tencent / BrowserSkill / main / install.ps1 | iex By default, the binary is installed under ~/.local/bin . Check it in the terminal or agent environment that will use it:
paragraphs.zh: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/install.ps1 | iex 默认情况下，二进制文件会被安装到 ~/.local/bin 目录下。 在将要使用它的终端或智能体环境中进行检查：

sents.en: irm https: // raw.githubusercontent.com / Tencent / BrowserSkill / main / install.ps1 | iex By default, the binary is installed under ~/.local/bin .
sents.zh: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/install.ps1 | iex 默认情况下，二进制文件会被安装到 ~/.local/bin 目录下。

sents.en: Check it in the terminal or agent environment that will use it:
sents.zh: 在将要使用它的终端或智能体环境中进行检查：

paragraphs.en: bsk --version If an already-running agent cannot find bsk , restart it to pick up the new PATH, or configure the installed binary's absolute path.
paragraphs.zh: bsk --version 如果已在运行的智能体找不到 bsk，请重启它以加载新的 PATH，或者配置已安装二进制文件的绝对路径。

paragraphs.en: Install it from the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons . Open its popup, enable the local connection, and check its status after starting the CLI.
paragraphs.zh: 从 Chrome 网上应用店或 Edge 加载项安装它。 打开它的弹出窗口，启用本地连接，并在启动 CLI 后检查其状态。

sents.en: Install it from the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons .
sents.zh: 从 Chrome 网上应用店或 Edge 加载项安装它。

sents.en: Open its popup, enable the local connection, and check its status after starting the CLI.
sents.zh: 打开它的弹出窗口，启用本地连接，并在启动 CLI 后检查其状态。

paragraphs.en: bsk install-skill Select your harness with Space , then press Enter . For non-interactive setup, choose it explicitly:
paragraphs.zh: bsk install-skill 用空格键选择你的 harness，然后按回车键。 对于非交互式设置，请显式指定它：

sents.en: bsk install-skill Select your harness with Space , then press Enter .
sents.zh: bsk install-skill 用空格键选择你的 harness，然后按回车键。

sents.en: For non-interactive setup, choose it explicitly:
sents.zh: 对于非交互式设置，请显式指定它：

paragraphs.en: bsk install-skill --harness cursor --json Use bsk install-skill --list to see supported targets and paths. Existing installations are skipped unless you explicitly replace them with --force . For another harness, copy the entire crates/bsk-cli/skill/ directory into its skills directory as browser-skill/ , including references/ .
paragraphs.zh: bsk install-skill --harness cursor --json 使用 bsk install-skill --list 查看支持的目标及其路径。 已有的安装会被跳过，除非你使用 --force 显式替换它们。 对于其他 harness，请将整个 crates/bsk-cli/skill/ 目录复制到其 skills 目录下并命名为 browser-skill/ ，包括 references/ 在内。

sents.en: bsk install-skill --harness cursor --json Use bsk install-skill --list to see supported targets and paths.
sents.zh: bsk install-skill --harness cursor --json 使用 bsk install-skill --list 查看支持的目标及其路径。

sents.en: Existing installations are skipped unless you explicitly replace them with --force .
sents.zh: 已有的安装会被跳过，除非你使用 --force 显式替换它们。

sents.en: For another harness, copy the entire crates/bsk-cli/skill/ directory into its skills directory as browser-skill/ , including references/ .
sents.zh: 对于其他 harness，请将整个 crates/bsk-cli/skill/ 目录复制到其 skills 目录下并命名为 browser-skill/ ，包括 references/ 在内。

paragraphs.en: DSH users should install the plugin instead; it includes the skill.
paragraphs.zh: DSH 用户应改为安装该插件；插件已包含该技能。

paragraphs.en: bsk doctor Resolve any failed checks and confirm that the extension shows Connected . Start a new agent session and check that it can discover browser-skill ; a successful doctor check alone does not confirm skill discovery.
paragraphs.zh: bsk doctor 解决所有未通过的检查项，并确认扩展显示为已连接（Connected）。 开启一个新的智能体会话，并检查它能否发现 browser-skill；仅 doctor 检查通过并不能确认技能已被发现。

sents.en: bsk doctor Resolve any failed checks and confirm that the extension shows Connected .
sents.zh: bsk doctor 解决所有未通过的检查项，并确认扩展显示为已连接（Connected）。

sents.en: Start a new agent session and check that it can discover browser-skill ; a successful doctor check alone does not confirm skill discovery.
sents.zh: 开启一个新的智能体会话，并检查它能否发现 browser-skill；仅 doctor 检查通过并不能确认技能已被发现。

paragraphs.en: Use browser-skill to open https://example.com, summarize the page, and end the browser session when finished. The agent opens its own window in the background, reads the page, returns the summary, and stops its task. External links or manually created tabs that land in the task window are moved to your most recently used normal window; a user window is created if none remain. Routing happens after tab creation, so a tab may briefly appear in the task window. Page-opened tabs and human assistance or recording are preserved. Harnesses that support skill slash commands can also use /browser-skill .
paragraphs.zh: 使用 browser-skill 打开 https://example.com，总结该页面，完成后结束浏览器会话。 智能体会在后台打开自己的窗口，读取页面，返回总结，然后停止其任务。 落入任务窗口的外部链接或手动创建的标签页会被移到你最近使用的普通窗口中；如果没有剩余的普通窗口，则会创建一个用户窗口。 路由发生在标签页创建之后，因此标签页可能会短暂地出现在任务窗口中。 由页面打开的标签页以及人工协助或录制内容会被保留。 支持技能斜杠命令的运行框架也可以使用 /browser-skill。

sents.en: Use browser-skill to open https://example.com, summarize the page, and end the browser session when finished.
sents.zh: 使用 browser-skill 打开 https://example.com，总结该页面，完成后结束浏览器会话。

sents.en: The agent opens its own window in the background, reads the page, returns the summary, and stops its task.
sents.zh: 智能体会在后台打开自己的窗口，读取页面，返回总结，然后停止其任务。

sents.en: External links or manually created tabs that land in the task window are moved to your most recently used normal window; a user window is created if none remain.
sents.zh: 落入任务窗口的外部链接或手动创建的标签页会被移到你最近使用的普通窗口中；如果没有剩余的普通窗口，则会创建一个用户窗口。

sents.en: Routing happens after tab creation, so a tab may briefly appear in the task window.
sents.zh: 路由发生在标签页创建之后，因此标签页可能会短暂地出现在任务窗口中。

sents.en: Page-opened tabs and human assistance or recording are preserved.
sents.zh: 由页面打开的标签页以及人工协助或录制内容会被保留。

sents.en: Harnesses that support skill slash commands can also use /browser-skill .
sents.zh: 支持技能斜杠命令的运行框架也可以使用 /browser-skill。

paragraphs.en: Chrome can still activate a window when a page opens a native popup. For observed task popups, the extension restores the previous Chrome window or minimized state if you have not switched windows. Chrome's public extension APIs cannot guarantee zero transient activation or restore focus to another application.
paragraphs.zh: 当页面打开原生弹窗时，Chrome 仍可能激活某个窗口。 对于被监测的任务弹窗，如果您没有切换窗口，扩展程序会恢复之前的 Chrome 窗口或最小化状态。 Chrome 的公开扩展程序 API 无法保证零瞬态激活，也无法将焦点恢复到另一个应用程序。

sents.en: Chrome can still activate a window when a page opens a native popup.
sents.zh: 当页面打开原生弹窗时，Chrome 仍可能激活某个窗口。

sents.en: For observed task popups, the extension restores the previous Chrome window or minimized state if you have not switched windows.
sents.zh: 对于被监测的任务弹窗，如果您没有切换窗口，扩展程序会恢复之前的 Chrome 窗口或最小化状态。

sents.en: Chrome's public extension APIs cannot guarantee zero transient activation or restore focus to another application.
sents.zh: Chrome 的公开扩展程序 API 无法保证零瞬态激活，也无法将焦点恢复到另一个应用程序。

paragraphs.en: Start a session and keep the returned session_id :
paragraphs.zh: 启动一个会话并保存返回的 session_id：

paragraphs.en: bsk session start --json Replace <id> with that value in each command below. With multiple connected browsers, select one using --browser <instance-id-or-name> when starting the session. Background creation is the default; --no-focus remains supported, and --focus explicitly brings the new window forward. Requests for human help and interactive recording still bring the relevant window forward.
paragraphs.zh: bsk session start --json 在下面每条命令中，将 <id> 替换为该值。 当连接了多个浏览器时，可在启动会话时使用 --browser <instance-id-or-name> 来选择其中一个。 后台创建是默认行为；--no-focus 仍然受支持，而 --focus 会明确将新窗口置前。 请求人工帮助和交互式录制时，仍会将相关窗口置前。

sents.en: bsk session start --json Replace <id> with that value in each command below.
sents.zh: bsk session start --json 在下面每条命令中，将 <id> 替换为该值。

sents.en: With multiple connected browsers, select one using --browser <instance-id-or-name> when starting the session.
sents.zh: 当连接了多个浏览器时，可在启动会话时使用 --browser <instance-id-or-name> 来选择其中一个。

sents.en: Background creation is the default; --no-focus remains supported, and --focus explicitly brings the new window forward.
sents.zh: 后台创建是默认行为；--no-focus 仍然受支持，而 --focus 会明确将新窗口置前。

sents.en: Requests for human help and interactive recording still bring the relevant window forward.
sents.zh: 请求人工帮助和交互式录制时，仍会将相关窗口置前。

paragraphs.en: bsk navigate https://example.com --session < id > bsk observe --session < id > bsk screenshot --session < id > --out example.png bsk session stop < id > Use bsk --help or bsk <command> --help for command options. Always stop your session when finished, including after a failed task; borrowed tabs are returned to their original window.
paragraphs.zh: bsk navigate https://example.com --session < id > bsk observe --session < id > bsk screenshot --session < id > --out example.png bsk session stop < id > 使用 bsk --help 或 bsk <command> --help 查看命令选项。 任务完成后（包括任务失败后）务必停止你的会话；借用的标签页会被归还到其原始窗口。

sents.en: bsk navigate https://example.com --session < id > bsk observe --session < id > bsk screenshot --session < id > --out example.png bsk session stop < id > Use bsk --help or bsk <command> --help for command options.
sents.zh: bsk navigate https://example.com --session < id > bsk observe --session < id > bsk screenshot --session < id > --out example.png bsk session stop < id > 使用 bsk --help 或 bsk <command> --help 查看命令选项。

sents.en: Always stop your session when finished, including after a failed task; borrowed tabs are returned to their original window.
sents.zh: 任务完成后（包括任务失败后）务必停止你的会话；借用的标签页会被归还到其原始窗口。

paragraphs.en: In WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy, or hosts that reap command children, the agent should reuse an existing daemon or run bsk daemon start --foreground in a managed background task, then verify it from a separate tool call. Follow the host setup guide for shared BSK_HOME , BSK_AUTO_START=0 , and the independent-terminal fallback when the host cannot keep a task alive.
paragraphs.zh: 在 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 或会回收命令子进程的宿主环境中，智能体应复用已有的守护进程，或在受管理的后台任务中运行 bsk daemon start --foreground，然后通过单独的工具调用来验证。 请遵循主机设置指南中关于共享 BSK_HOME、BSK_AUTO_START=0 的配置，以及宿主无法保持任务存活时的独立终端回退方案。

sents.en: In WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy, or hosts that reap command children, the agent should reuse an existing daemon or run bsk daemon start --foreground in a managed background task, then verify it from a separate tool call.
sents.zh: 在 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 或会回收命令子进程的宿主环境中，智能体应复用已有的守护进程，或在受管理的后台任务中运行 bsk daemon start --foreground，然后通过单独的工具调用来验证。

sents.en: Follow the host setup guide for shared BSK_HOME , BSK_AUTO_START=0 , and the independent-terminal fallback when the host cannot keep a task alive.
sents.zh: 请遵循主机设置指南中关于共享 BSK_HOME、BSK_AUTO_START=0 的配置，以及宿主无法保持任务存活时的独立终端回退方案。

paragraphs.en: The DSH plugin adds native bsk_* tools, browser task previews, and screenshot results to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It uses the same bsk CLI and extension and includes its own BrowserSkill skill.
paragraphs.zh: DSH 插件为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加了原生的 bsk_* 工具、浏览器任务预览以及截图结果。 它使用相同的 bsk CLI 和扩展，并包含自己的 BrowserSkill 技能。

sents.en: The DSH plugin adds native bsk_* tools, browser task previews, and screenshot results to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
sents.zh: DSH 插件为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加了原生的 bsk_* 工具、浏览器任务预览以及截图结果。

sents.en: It uses the same bsk CLI and extension and includes its own BrowserSkill skill.
sents.zh: 它使用相同的 bsk CLI 和扩展，并包含自己的 BrowserSkill 技能。

paragraphs.en: Upgrading to 0.3.3: update the CLI and extension before the plugin. The six browser_* tools have been renamed to bsk_* , without aliases for the old names. Update custom tool calls and policies, restart the DSH profile, and invoke /browser-skill again in existing conversations. See the migration guide .
paragraphs.zh: 升级到 0.3.3：先更新 CLI 和扩展，再更新插件。 六个 browser_* 工具已重命名为 bsk_*，旧名称不再提供别名。 请更新自定义工具调用和策略，重启 DSH 配置，并在现有会话中重新调用 /browser-skill。 请参阅迁移指南。

sents.en: Upgrading to 0.3.3: update the CLI and extension before the plugin.
sents.zh: 升级到 0.3.3：先更新 CLI 和扩展，再更新插件。

sents.en: The six browser_* tools have been renamed to bsk_* , without aliases for the old names.
sents.zh: 六个 browser_* 工具已重命名为 bsk_*，旧名称不再提供别名。

sents.en: Update custom tool calls and policies, restart the DSH profile, and invoke /browser-skill again in existing conversations.
sents.zh: 请更新自定义工具调用和策略，重启 DSH 配置，并在现有会话中重新调用 /browser-skill。

sents.en: See the migration guide .
sents.zh: 请参阅迁移指南。

paragraphs.en: With DeepSeek Harness, pnpm, and bsk installed and the extension connected, add the plugin to your profile:
paragraphs.zh: 在安装好 DeepSeek Harness、pnpm 和 bsk 并连接扩展后，将该插件添加到你的配置文件（profile）中：

paragraphs.en: dsh plugin --profile web add @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin dsh --profile web Replace web with your profile name. Make sure bsk is available on the PATH used to start DSH, or set the plugin's bskPath . In a conversation, invoke /browser-skill and describe the task. A separate bsk install-skill step is not needed.
paragraphs.zh: dsh plugin --profile web add @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin dsh --profile web 将 web 替换为你的配置文件名称。 请确保 bsk 在启动 DSH 所用的 PATH 中可用，或者设置该插件的 bskPath 。 在对话中调用 /browser-skill 并描述任务。 无需单独执行 bsk install-skill 步骤。

sents.en: dsh plugin --profile web add @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin dsh --profile web Replace web with your profile name.
sents.zh: dsh plugin --profile web add @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin dsh --profile web 将 web 替换为你的配置文件名称。

sents.en: Make sure bsk is available on the PATH used to start DSH, or set the plugin's bskPath .
sents.zh: 请确保 bsk 在启动 DSH 所用的 PATH 中可用，或者设置该插件的 bskPath 。

sents.en: In a conversation, invoke /browser-skill and describe the task.

paragraphs.en: Give your agent the browser evidence behind a bug. Start capture before reproducing an issue on a website you are authorized to debug, then inspect the result in the extension or through the agent.

paragraphs.en: Use browser-skill to investigate why saving the form on http://localhost:3000 fails. Start website debugging before reproducing it, inspect the request, response and console, then export the evidence and end the session. From the extension, open Quick Actions → Website debugging for an existing task. The evidence page connects the operation timeline, requests, Console, page context, Performance, and API analysis. Its history remains accessible after the task ends, even without a daemon connection. A new agent task needs a user-provided export to inspect an ended task's history.
paragraphs.zh: 使用浏览器技能（browser-skill）调查为什么在 http://localhost:3000 上保存表单会失败。 在复现问题之前先启动网站调试，检查请求、响应和控制台，然后导出证据并结束会话。 从扩展中打开「快速操作」→ 针对现有任务的「网站调试」。 证据页面将操作时间线、请求、控制台（Console）、页面上下文、性能和 API 分析关联起来。 任务结束后，其历史记录仍然可以访问，即使没有守护进程连接。 新的智能体任务需要用户提供导出文件，才能查看已结束任务的历史记录。

paragraphs.en: BrowserSkill does not operate a mandatory cloud service or collect product telemetry. Automation results go to your selected daemon or gateway and the agent using it; that agent or service may process or retain them under its own policies. The extension does not independently call an AI provider.
paragraphs.zh: BrowserSkill 不运营强制性的云服务，也不收集产品遥测数据。 自动化结果会发送到你选择的守护进程或网关以及使用它的智能体；该智能体或服务可能依据其自身策略处理或保留这些结果。 该扩展不会独立调用 AI 提供商。

Video frames are not automatically redacted; review visible content before sharing.

paragraphs.en: Finish active browser tasks, then update the CLI:
paragraphs.zh: 完成当前浏览器任务后，再更新 CLI：

paragraphs.en: bsk update --yes For the default local setup, this installs the new executable and checks that it runs while the daemon keeps serving, then restarts the daemon from it on the same port. If the restarted daemon does not become ready, the previous executable is put back and the daemon is restarted from it. A daemon started with --foreground is left running on the previous version; restart it in its terminal or supervisor. So is a background daemon when bsk update runs where it could not start one again, such as inside a sandbox whose Windows Job forbids breakaway; restart it with bsk daemon restart outside the sandbox. If you use the installer to replace the binary, restart the daemon afterwards with bsk daemon restart .
paragraphs.zh: bsk update --yes 对于默认的本地设置，此命令会安装新的可执行文件，并在守护进程继续提供服务的同时检查新文件能否正常运行，然后从新文件在同一端口重启守护进程。 如果重启后的守护进程未能就绪，则恢复之前的可执行文件，并从它重启守护进程。 以 --foreground 启动的守护进程会继续运行旧版本；请在其终端或监督器中重启它。 当 bsk update 在无法重新启动后台守护进程的环境中运行时（例如在禁止脱离的 Windows 作业（Job）的沙箱内），后台守护进程同样会继续运行旧版本；请在沙箱外使用 bsk daemon restart 重启它。 如果你使用安装程序替换了二进制文件，请随后使用 bsk daemon restart . 重启守护进程。

paragraphs.en: A daemon that bsk started in the background also checks for a new release every 30 minutes and, while no agent session is active, installs it the same way. It then starts a daemon from the new executable and exits only once a daemon of the new version serves the same port. If the new daemon exits or is not ready within 20 seconds, it is stopped, and the running daemon puts the previous executable back, serves again on the same port, and retries that release after 6 hours. Browser connections drop for a moment during a handover and reconnect. A daemon that stops for another reason during an update, such as going idle, puts the previous executable back first. A daemon started with --foreground belongs to its terminal or supervisor, so it only reports new releases: run bsk update , then restart the daemon there. If bsk cannot write next to its executable, it only reports new releases; update it with the installer or package manager you used. Set BSK_AUTO_UPDATE=off to disable daemon-side auto-update while keeping manual bsk update available.
paragraphs.zh: bsk 在后台启动的守护进程也会每 30 分钟检查一次新版本，并在没有智能体会话处于活动状态时，以相同方式安装新版本。 随后它会从新的可执行文件启动一个守护进程，只有当新版本的守护进程在同一端口上提供服务后才退出。 如果新守护进程退出或在 20 秒内未就绪，它会被停止，正在运行的守护进程会换回之前的可执行文件，继续在同一端口提供服务，并在 6 小时后重试该版本。 在交接期间，浏览器连接会短暂中断然后重新连接。 如果守护进程在更新期间因其他原因停止（例如进入空闲状态），它会先换回之前的可执行文件。 使用 --foreground 启动的守护进程归属于其终端或监管进程，因此它只会报告新版本：请运行 bsk update，然后在该处重启守护进程。 如果 bsk 无法在其可执行文件旁边写入，它只会报告新版本；请使用你当初安装时所用的安装程序或包管理器进行更新。 设置 BSK_AUTO_UPDATE=off 可以禁用守护进程端的自动更新，同时保留手动运行 bsk update 的能力。

sents.en: A daemon that bsk started in the background also checks for a new release every 30 minutes and, while no agent session is active, installs it the same way.
sents.zh: bsk 在后台启动的守护进程也会每 30 分钟检查一次新版本，并在没有智能体会话处于活动状态时，以相同方式安装新版本。

sents.en: It then starts a daemon from the new executable and exits only once a daemon of the new version serves the same port.
sents.zh: 随后它会从新的可执行文件启动一个守护进程，只有当新版本的守护进程在同一端口上提供服务后才退出。

sents.en: If the new daemon exits or is not ready within 20 seconds, it is stopped, and the running daemon puts the previous executable back, serves again on the same port, and retries that release after 6 hours.
sents.zh: 如果新守护进程退出或在 20 秒内未就绪，它会被停止，正在运行的守护进程会换回之前的可执行文件，继续在同一端口提供服务，并在 6 小时后重试该版本。

sents.en: Browser connections drop for a moment during a handover and reconnect.
sents.zh: 在交接期间，浏览器连接会短暂中断然后重新连接。

sents.en: A daemon that stops for another reason during an update, such as going idle, puts the previous executable back first.
sents.zh: 如果守护进程在更新期间因其他原因停止（例如进入空闲状态），它会先换回之前的可执行文件。

sents.en: A daemon started with --foreground belongs to its terminal or supervisor, so it only reports new releases: run bsk update , then restart the daemon there.
sents.zh: 使用 --foreground 启动的守护进程归属于其终端或监管进程，因此它只会报告新版本：请运行 bsk update，然后在该处重启守护进程。

sents.en: If bsk cannot write next to its executable, it only reports new releases; update it with the installer or package manager you used.
sents.zh: 如果 bsk 无法在其可执行文件旁边写入，它只会报告新版本；请使用你当初安装时所用的安装程序或包管理器进行更新。

sents.en: Set BSK_AUTO_UPDATE=off to disable daemon-side auto-update while keeping manual bsk update available.
sents.zh: 设置 BSK_AUTO_UPDATE=off 可以禁用守护进程端的自动更新，同时保留手动运行 bsk update 的能力。

paragraphs.en: bsk doctor shows the last update attempt; update-state.json in the bsk home keeps its stage, result and error. Updates of one executable run one at a time, even from different bsk homes, through .bsk.update.lock ( .bsk.exe.update.lock on Windows), which stays next to it. Until an update is confirmed, the previous executable stays next to the new one as .bsk.old-* ( .bsk.exe.old-* on Windows); one that is still running remains until its process exits, and a later daemon start removes it. On Windows, self-update renames the running executable, which NTFS supports; where the file system refuses, the update fails and leaves the installation unchanged. bsk supports Windows 10 and Windows Server 2016 or later.
paragraphs.zh: bsk doctor 会显示最近一次更新尝试；bsk 主目录中的 update-state.json 会保留其阶段、结果和错误信息。 每个可执行文件的更新一次只运行一个，即使来自不同的 bsk 主目录也是如此，通过位于其旁边的 .bsk.update.lock（Windows 上为 .bsk.exe.update.lock）实现。 在更新被确认之前，旧的可执行文件会以 .bsk.old-*（Windows 上为 .bsk.exe.old-*）的形式保留在新文件旁边；仍在运行的文件会保留到其进程退出为止，之后 daemon 启动时会将其删除。 在 Windows 上，自更新会对正在运行的可执行文件进行重命名，NTFS 支持这一操作；如果文件系统拒绝，更新将失败并保持安装不变。bsk 支持 Windows 10 和 Windows Server 2016 或更高版本。

paragraphs.en: Update the extension through its browser store. Update the DSH plugin separately, then restart its profile:
paragraphs.zh: 通过浏览器商店更新该扩展。 单独更新 DSH 插件，然后重启其配置文件：

sents.en: Update the extension through its browser store.
sents.zh: 通过浏览器商店更新该扩展。

sents.en: Update the DSH plugin separately, then restart its profile:
sents.zh: 单独更新 DSH 插件，然后重启其配置文件：

paragraphs.en: dsh plugin --profile web update @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin --latest Check bsk --version , bsk status , and bsk doctor . Keep the CLI, running daemon, extension, and optional DSH plugin on matching releases for new features. This README describes the current repository; store builds can lag during review. Check the changelog and releases for availability.
paragraphs.zh: dsh plugin --profile web update @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin --latest 请检查 bsk --version、bsk status 和 bsk doctor。 若要使用新功能，请保持 CLI、运行中的守护进程、扩展和可选的 DSH 插件使用相匹配的版本。 本 README 描述的是当前仓库的情况；商店构建版本在审核期间可能会滞后。 有关可用性，请查看更新日志和发布页面。

sents.en: dsh plugin --profile web update @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin --latest Check bsk --version , bsk status , and bsk doctor .
sents.zh: dsh plugin --profile web update @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin --latest 请检查 bsk --version、bsk status 和 bsk doctor。

sents.en: Keep the CLI, running daemon, extension, and optional DSH plugin on matching releases for new features.
sents.zh: 若要使用新功能，请保持 CLI、运行中的守护进程、扩展和可选的 DSH 插件使用相匹配的版本。

sents.zh: 有关可用性，请查看更新日志和发布页面。

paragraphs.en: Managed CLI skills update on daemon startup, session start , or doctor while their files remain unchanged. Local edits and custom skills are preserved. Start a new agent session to load updated instructions; doctor reports any paused skill updates.
paragraphs.zh: 在守护进程启动、会话开始或执行 doctor 时管理 CLI 技能的更新，同时其文件保持不变。 本地编辑和自定义技能会被保留。 启动一个新的智能体会话以加载更新后的指令；doctor 会报告任何已暂停的技能更新。

sents.en: Managed CLI skills update on daemon startup, session start , or doctor while their files remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 在守护进程启动、会话开始或执行 doctor 时管理 CLI 技能的更新，同时其文件保持不变。

sents.en: Local edits and custom skills are preserved.
sents.zh: 本地编辑和自定义技能会被保留。

sents.en: Start a new agent session to load updated instructions; doctor reports any paused skill updates.
sents.zh: 启动一个新的智能体会话以加载更新后的指令；doctor 会报告任何已暂停的技能更新。

paragraphs.en: Stop the daemon in its owning host or supervisor, update with bsk update --yes --no-restart-daemon , then start it there with its original flags and BSK_HOME . Use BSK_AUTO_START=0 in agent commands during this process. Follow the sandbox or remote guide for your deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 在守护进程所属的主机或管理器（supervisor）中停止该守护进程，使用 bsk update --yes --no-restart-daemon 进行更新，然后使用原来的启动参数和 BSK_HOME 在原处重新启动它。 在此过程中，请在智能体命令中使用 BSK_AUTO_START=0。 请根据你的部署方式参考沙箱或远程部署指南。

sents.en: Stop the daemon in its owning host or supervisor, update with bsk update --yes --no-restart-daemon , then start it there with its original flags and BSK_HOME .

sents.en: Use BSK_AUTO_START=0 in agent commands during this process.
sents.zh: 在此过程中，请在智能体命令中使用 BSK_AUTO_START=0。

sents.en: Follow the sandbox or remote guide for your deployment.
sents.zh: 请根据你的部署方式参考沙箱或远程部署指南。

paragraphs.en: The repository is a Rust + pnpm workspace. For a source build, use Rust stable, Node.js 22, and the pnpm version declared in package.json :
paragraphs.zh: 该仓库是一个 Rust + pnpm 工作区。 若进行源码构建，请使用 Rust stable、Node.js 22 以及 package.json 中声明的 pnpm 版本：

sents.zh: 该仓库是一个 Rust + pnpm 工作区。

sents.en: For a source build, use Rust stable, Node.js 22, and the pnpm version declared in package.json :
sents.zh: 若进行源码构建，请使用 Rust stable、Node.js 22 以及 package.json 中声明的 pnpm 版本：

paragraphs.en: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile cargo build --release --locked pnpm ext:build The CLI is built under target/release/ ; load apps/extension/dist/chrome-mv3/ as an unpacked extension. For extension development, use pnpm ext:dev .
paragraphs.zh: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile cargo build --release --locked pnpm ext:build CLI 会构建到 target/release/ 目录下；将 apps/extension/dist/chrome-mv3/ 作为未打包的扩展加载。 如需进行扩展开发，请使用 pnpm ext:dev。

sents.en: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile cargo build --release --locked pnpm ext:build The CLI is built under target/release/ ; load apps/extension/dist/chrome-mv3/ as an unpacked extension.
sents.zh: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile cargo build --release --locked pnpm ext:build CLI 会构建到 target/release/ 目录下；将 apps/extension/dist/chrome-mv3/ 作为未打包的扩展加载。

sents.en: For extension development, use pnpm ext:dev .
sents.zh: 如需进行扩展开发，请使用 pnpm ext:dev。

paragraphs.en: Run cargo test --workspace --locked , pnpm ext:test , and pnpm lint for the relevant checks. See the browser evaluation guide for reproducible browser cases. Bug reports and focused contributions are welcome through GitHub Issues and pull requests; remove sensitive data before attaching browser evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 运行 cargo test --workspace --locked、pnpm ext:test 和 pnpm lint 以进行相关检查。 有关可复现的浏览器用例，请参阅浏览器评估指南。 欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 和拉取请求提交缺陷报告和有针对性的贡献；在附加浏览器证据之前，请先移除敏感数据。
